name: Dawn of Ragnarok
source:
Over a thousand years ago, the mythical world was torn from the mundane one, reduced to silent secrets hiding just out of reach.

And now, the threat of the end of the world looms over all.

This is a story of a simple fertility spirit, or fairy - a pooka - who is prophesied to halt that end; it is the story of their journey to find that destiny, and the story of the many people that they meet along the way.

It is a story of secrets, and a story of trust. It is a story about myths and gods and their conflicts, and it is a story about the mundane struggles of people.

It is a story of a great many hardships, of pain and suffering, but most of all it is also a story of hope.

[From [url=https://trans-bun.itch.io/dawn-of-ragnarok]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一千多年前，神話世界與凡塵俗世被生生割裂，化作了隱藏在觸不可及之處的無聲秘密。

而如今，世界末日的威脅正籠罩著眾生。

這是一個關於一位單純的豐饒精怪（或者說妖精）——普卡的故事，預言稱它將阻止末日的降臨；這也是它踏上追尋宿命之旅的故事，以及它沿途所遇形形色色之人的故事。

這是一個關於秘密與信任的故事；一個關於神話、諸神及其紛爭的故事，也是一個關於凡人世俗掙扎的故事。

這是一個歷經重重磨難、充滿痛楚與煎熬的故事，但歸根結底，它也是一個關於希望的故事。

[引自[url=https://trans-bun.itch.io/dawn-of-ragnarok]Itch.io[/url]]
